8fe32fa9f681db34.description: Job description About the job MACHINERY OUTFITTING ENGINEER (PS) We are seeking an experienced Machinery Outfitting Engineer (Procurement Support) with 5–10 years of experience in marine and shipbuilding projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing engineering support to machinery procurement activities, reviewing technical specifications and vendor documentation, evaluating supplier offers, coordinating with equipment vendors, and ensuring that procured machinery and equipment meet project requirements, technical specifications, and applicable marine standards. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Provide engineering and technical support for machinery outfitting procurement activities in marine, shipbuilding, and offshore vessel projects. Review project specifications, equipment lists, machinery arrangements, and procurement requirements to identify suitable equipment and suppliers. Prepare and review technical requisitions, equipment specifications, datasheets, and other procurement-related engineering documents. Review vendor quotations, technical proposals, and compliance statements to ensure alignment with project specifications and technical requirements. Perform technical bid evaluations (TBEs) and prepare technical comparison sheets for machinery and equipment procurement. Coordinate with procurement teams, engineering disciplines, equipment manufacturers, and suppliers to clarify technical requirements and resolve queries. Review vendor drawings, equipment layouts, installation requirements, foundation details, and interface information for compliance with project design requirements. Verify machinery dimensions, weights, power requirements, utility connections, operating conditions, and maintenance clearances against project requirements. Ensure compatibility of procured machinery with vessel layouts, machinery spaces, foundations, piping systems, electrical interfaces, and other outfitting disciplines. Support the preparation and review of purchase requisitions, material requisitions, and technical documentation required for procurement packages. Respond to technical queries from vendors and procurement teams and coordinate with relevant engineering disciplines to resolve discrepancies. Monitor vendor document submissions and coordinate technical reviews to ensure timely approval and compliance with project schedules. Support technical clarification meetings with suppliers and participate in vendor evaluations, where required. Review vendor deviations, proposed alternatives, and technical exceptions and coordinate with the engineering team for assessment and approval. Ensure compliance with applicable marine classification requirements, project specifications, international standards, and client requirements. Maintain procurement engineering records, technical bid evaluation documents, vendor data, and equipment documentation in accordance with project procedures. Support inspection, testing, and equipment delivery coordination by ensuring that technical and documentation requirements are fulfilled. Coordinate with construction, production, and installation teams to address procurement-related technical issues and ensure equipment suitability for installation. Ensure procurement engineering deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. KEY QUALIFICATIONS: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or an equivalent engineering discipline. 5–10 years of relevant experience in machinery procurement engineering, technical procurement support, or machinery outfitting within marine, shipbuilding, shipyard, or offshore vessel projects. Strong experience in reviewing technical specifications, equipment datasheets, vendor quotations, and supplier documentation. Experience conducting technical bid evaluations (TBEs), preparing technical comparison sheets, and reviewing supplier compliance against project requirements. Good understanding of marine machinery systems, equipment arrangements, machinery foundations, installation requirements, and multidisciplinary interfaces. Experience coordinating with procurement teams, engineering disciplines, equipment manufacturers, and suppliers to resolve technical queries. Familiarity with marine classification society requirements, applicable shipbuilding standards, and project specifications. Understanding of machinery interfaces with piping, HVAC, electrical, instrumentation, and hull structure disciplines. Experience with marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting, or other shipbuilding CAD software, is an advantage. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience maintaining technical procurement documentation and vendor data registers. Experience in new-build shipbuilding projects, offshore vessels, FPSOs, or similar marine engineering projects is preferred. Exposure to international shipyards, marine EPC contractors, or multidisciplinary engineering environments is preferred. Strong technical evaluation, analytical, documentation, coordination, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and procurement environment. 8fc05877fa0ffbd6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مكون للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية من مرحلة الدراسة الأولية وحتى التنفيذ، مع ضمان مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بدقة. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية أو ما يعادلها. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الإنشائية أو الإشراف على المشاريع. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم والمتابعة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني في شركة مكون للمقاولات ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في مدينة الرياض، حيث يساهم في مشاريع إنشائية متنوعة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بالمهام الموكلة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقدم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات الوظيفة.

8fdb675a8388d9cb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الموافي للمقاولات العامة عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة، حيث سيتولى المهندس مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى صيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تحديد مسارات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وإعداد مخططاتها ومواصفاتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص الأعطال في الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وتنفيذ إجراءات الصيانة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق شركة الموافي للمقاولات العامة في مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمهام المشروع والصيانة الدورية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا في مكة المكرمة للتقديم على هذا الدور.

8f2f07762981e08d.description: Job Summary: We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Interior Designer specializing in furniture and carpet design. The role involves developing creative designs and concepts that meet project and client requirements, with a strong focus on colors, materials, patterns, and aesthetic details. 8f1e6de452b34e12.description: About the Role Tabby is seeking a Lead Anti-Fraud Officer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves independently leading complex governance, risk, and compliance activities, serving as a subject matter expert in areas such as enterprise information security governance, risk management frameworks, regulatory compliance, or third-party risk management. The Lead Anti-Fraud Officer will produce high-quality GRC deliverables, mentor junior and mid-level team members, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the organization's GRC framework, risk treatment processes, and compliance reporting mechanisms. This position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead the development, review, and continuous improvement of information security policies, standards, procedures, and governance frameworks. Serve as the subject matter expert for assigned regulatory domains, interpreting requirements and translating them into implementable control objectives. Monitor and track regulatory and legal developments affecting information security, assessing impact and recommending updates to the governance framework. Prepare and review governance documentation, including RACI matrices, security charter updates, and governance committee packs, presenting findings to senior stakeholders. Lead the preparation of regulatory self-assessments and compliance attestations, coordinating evidence gathering and quality-reviewing submissions. Mentor GR1–GR2 team members on governance documentation quality, regulatory interpretation, and risk assessment methodology. Enterprise Risk Management Lead complex enterprise information security risk assessments, applying advanced methodologies to produce risk profiles aligned with the organization's risk appetite. Own and maintain the enterprise information security risk register, ensuring accuracy, currency, and appropriate escalation of significant risks. Lead Business Impact Analysis (BIA) processes for critical business functions, coordinating with asset owners and analyzing recovery requirements. Design and execute control effectiveness testing programmes, producing findings reports with gap analysis and risk-ranked remediation recommendations. Lead third-party information security risk management, designing assessment frameworks, conducting vendor reviews, and maintaining the third-party risk register. Produce executive-quality risk reporting with trend analysis, emerging risk identification, and treatment progress tracking. Compliance Programme Delivery Lead compliance monitoring activities for CFFR, NCA ECC, PDPL, ISO 27001, and PCI-DSS, producing gap analyses, treatment plans, and periodic compliance status reports. Manage internal and external audit cycles, coordinating evidence collection, reviewing evidence quality, engaging with auditors, and tracking remediation. Design and deliver the security awareness programme, producing targeted content, conducting awareness sessions, and analyzing effectiveness metrics. Develop and maintain GRC programme metrics dashboards, ensuring KPIs and KRIs are accurately measured and presented. Lead the integration of information security requirements into third-party contracts, procurement processes, and major project onboarding. Contribute to the development of the information security programme strategy, identifying capability improvement opportunities and recommending investment priorities. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Knowledge Leadership Serve as the primary GRC point of contact for assigned business and technology teams, providing expert guidance on security requirements, risk treatment, and compliance obligations. Lead information classification and security requirements reviews for significant IT, product, and business projects. Contribute to the GRC knowledge base by developing reusable templates, guidance documents, and training materials. Represent the GRC function in cross-functional working groups, project steering committees, and regulatory workstreams. Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by management. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field, demonstrating expertise in governance, risk, and compliance activities within a regulatory environment, preferably within Fintech in Saudi Arabia.

8f7a82016d99be59.description: About the Role Munshi HR Solutions Ltd is seeking a Poultry Veterinarian for a contract position in Saudi Arabia. This role is central to ensuring the health and welfare of poultry birds through diligent monitoring, disease diagnosis, and the implementation of preventative health measures. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Poultry Veterinarian will be responsible for overseeing the comprehensive health management of poultry flocks. This includes proactive health monitoring, accurate diagnosis and treatment of diseases, and the development and execution of effective health programs. The role requires close collaboration with various farm teams to uphold biosecurity standards and optimize flock performance. Key Responsibilities Monitor the overall health and welfare of poultry birds. Diagnose and treat poultry diseases and health problems. Conduct regular flock health checks and clinical examinations. Develop and implement vaccination and medication programs. Monitor vaccination effectiveness and maintain proper records. Advise farm teams on biosecurity and disease prevention measures. Conduct post-mortem examinations and identify causes of mortality. Monitor feed, water quality, and flock performance from a veterinary perspective. Coordinate with farm, hatchery, feed, and production teams on health-related issues. Maintain veterinary records and prepare regular reports on flock health and disease status. Experience and Work Type Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in poultry veterinary medicine. This is a contract position, offering an opportunity to contribute significantly to poultry health management within a professional environment. Location This role is based in Saudi Arabia, providing an opportunity to work within the region's agricultural sector. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be disclosed to qualified candidates.

8fe2bd8edc19b56e.description: About Blooming Wear Blooming Wear is a Saudi brand focused on providing women with comfortable and confidence-boosting apparel for various stages of life. The company emphasizes thoughtful design, quality, and care to meet daily needs in a respectful and empowering manner. Inspired by the butterfly, the brand's identity reflects softness, transformation, and elegance. The Role of Financial Business Analyst Blooming Wear is seeking a Financial Business Analyst to join its team in Makkah, covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is responsible for independently preparing, analyzing, and improving management reporting across the Group and its business units. The analyst will manage monthly P&L reporting, support budgeting and forecasting, conduct performance analysis, and prepare management presentations. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Prepare accurate monthly P&L reports for assigned companies, channels, and business units within agreed timelines. Reconcile management reports to the general ledger and investigate material differences with Accounting. Support annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and scenario models in coordination with business owners. Analyze revenue, gross profit, EBITDA, net profit, margins, expenses, and key operational drivers. Assess profitability by company, channel, customer, category, product, store, project, or other relevant dimension. Analyze inventory, receivables, payables, and cash conversion drivers, highlighting emerging risks. Validate source data and reconcile information across ERP, sales, inventory, courier, and other operating systems. Automate recurring reports and analysis using advanced Excel, Power Query, Power BI, and other approved tools. Maintain clear review checks, documentation, and audit trails for financial models and management reports. Identify reporting gaps, inefficient processes, and control weaknesses, proposing practical improvements. Financial Planning and Analysis The Financial Business Analyst will review and challenge assumptions for sales, gross margin, operating expenses, working capital, and cash flow. This includes tracking actual performance against budget, forecast, and prior year, and providing reliable outlook updates. The role also involves building sensitivity and what-if analyses to support commercial and operational decisions. Data Management and Automation A key aspect of this role involves converting financial and operational data into clear business insights, challenging results where necessary, and improving recurring reports through standardization and automation. The analyst will support the integration of Dynamics 365 data into dashboards and standardized management reports, and use AI-enabled tools responsibly to accelerate analysis and presentation preparation. Cross-Functional Coordination and Continuous Improvement The analyst will work closely with Accounting to ensure transactions are complete and correctly classified for management reporting. This role requires partnering with Commercial, Operations, Supply Chain, IT, and subsidiary teams to understand performance drivers and following up independently on missing inputs and unresolved variances. The analyst will also support ad-hoc financial analysis and strategic projects assigned by the Finance Manager.

Support the day-to-day operations of the computer network. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a related field. 8f0b02c6c68bce99.description: About MEMF Electrical Industries Co. MEMF Electrical Industries Co., Ltd. is the industrial arm of KFB Holding Group, dedicated to supporting Saudi Arabia’s power infrastructure. The company specializes in locally engineered, high-quality electrical products, operating advanced manufacturing facilities in Riyadh. MEMF produces a wide range of solutions for utility and industrial customers, including smart energy meters, circuit breakers, LV & MV instrument transformers, LV & MV switchgear solutions (up to 36 kV), distribution & power transformers (up to 10 MVA), and FRP meter boxes & feeder pillars. The role involves providing technical support, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, and assisting in network infrastructure design and implementation. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, modify, and perform minor repairs on computer hardware and software systems. Resolve technical support tickets and troubleshoot hardware, software, and process-related issues. Test computer components to maintain system functionality and performance. Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining network infrastructure. Consult with users to identify appropriate hardware and software requirements and assist with purchasing requests. Evaluate technical applications and recommend solutions to improve system capabilities. Test new software and programs for compatibility with existing systems and hardware. Gather and analyze technical purchasing options and assist in vendor evaluation. Test new programs against established standards and specifications and make necessary modifications. Evaluate vendor-supplied software based on user requirements and compatibility with existing systems. What We Offer Hands-on experience in IT and technical support. Professional development and learning opportunities. A supportive and collaborative work environment. 8f0f23e6d989c055.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is seeking a Director of Nursery Operations for Botanica, a subsidiary specializing in sustainable greenery for Red Sea Global's destinations. Botanica integrates new species with local flora, operating across 1 million square meters with a focus on sustainability. Since 2020, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants, with a target of 30 million by 2030, contributing to the natural landscapes of The Red Sea and Amaala. This full-time position is based in Tabuk, specifically in Umluj and Tabuk, and requires over 10 years of experience. Role Purpose The Director of Nursery Operations will lead the operational functions of the 180-hectare Botanica site. This includes overseeing field operations, plant maintenance, plant protection, irrigation and water management (2,000–4,000 m3 per day), soil mix and growing media production, logistics, receiving and dispatch, and facilities, fleet, and workshop management. The primary objective is to ensure plant health, timely and complete order fulfillment, and safe and efficient site operations for all business units. Key Responsibilities Manage and organize all nursery areas, including planting zones (1,533,100 m2), shading (173,800 m2), and mother stock areas. Oversee routine maintenance of nursery stock, including weeding, pruning, spacing, cleaning, and daily plant health monitoring. Implement plant protection measures in accordance with the IPM and biosecurity program. Design, operate, and maintain the irrigation network and pump stations, setting schedules by zone and season. Monitor water quality, flow, and consumption, focusing on reducing freshwater use through TSE, drip, and smart irrigation. Develop and maintain contingency plans for water supply interruptions and system failures. Source raw materials and produce consistent soil mixes and substrates to approved recipes, supplying internal sections and external clients. Manage receiving of local and imported plants and materials, coordinating with Biosecurity for inspection and quarantine. Plan and execute dispatch against confirmed orders, including picking, loading, transport, and delivery documentation. Coordinate imports through the bonded facility and maintain accurate stock movement records. Implement preventive and corrective maintenance plans for facilities, greenhouses, shade structures, and equipment. Manage fleet availability, utilization, and compliance, overseeing workshops and the asset register. Manage the Nursery Operations budget, including labor, water, energy, fuel, spares, and maintenance. Allocate manpower, machinery, and transport across sections, supporting Production and Landscape Maintenance requests. Report monthly KPIs and identify operational risks with corrective actions. Lead section heads, supervisors, and operatives, setting competency and training standards. Control high-risk activities in collaboration with HSSE, including machinery, chemicals, lifting, driving, and heat stress. Fulfill the responsibilities of a Department Head as outlined in Section ** Ensure adherence to all relevant Botanica and RSG Group policies, delegation of authority (DoA), processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Champion the safety, quality, and environmental management system (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and the compliance management system (ISO 37301). Identify and lead opportunities for continuous improvement in departmental systems, processes, and practices, focusing on cost reduction, productivity, and client value. Work Environment and Context Nursery Operations supports all Botanica business units, including Production, Landscape Maintenance, and Commercial. The role is critical, as operational failures, such as irrigation outages during peak heat or equipment breakdowns, can lead to significant losses and project delays. This position requires a proactive approach focused on prevention and redundancy to mitigate risks effectively. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in nursery operations or a related field. Demonstrated leadership experience in managing large-scale operations and teams. Strong understanding of sustainable practices in horticulture and nursery management. Experience with irrigation systems, water management, and soil science. Proficiency in budget management, resource allocation, and performance reporting. Knowledge of HSSE standards and compliance management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 37301).
